name: Andrew Trujillo
bio: I am a cybersecurity major with a minor in AI engineering at BYU-Idaho. I love to play video games, Magic: The Gathering, and I love coding!
favoriteWhy: I love to play Magic: The Gathering here, and I love the community-focused vibe!

name: Asher Smith
bio: I am a software engineering major with a focus on full stack web development at BYU-Idaho. I love learning new things and finding fun wherever I go and whatever I do!
favoriteWhy: They have really good, high-quality ice cream, karaoke nights, and a large upstairs game room with a bunch of classic board and card games!

name: Dallas Walker
bio: I am a student at BYU-Idaho studying data analytics and software development. I have a passion for using AI and technology to solve practical problems. I love building innovative projects, learning new tools, and creating technology that helps people.

name: Vinicius Paredes Cabral
bio: I'm half Spanish and half Brazilian, and I'm currently studying Computer Science at BYU-Idaho. I'm a huge fan of good meat and absolutely love cooking it. I also really enjoy hiking, spending time outdoors in nature, and chasing a good adrenaline rush.
